description: CPU-optimized, privacy-preserving enterprise RAG pipeline utilizing hybrid SQLite FTS5 (BM25) + dense ONNX vector embeddings with Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF), BGE-Reranker ONNX, and local ONNX Small Language Model generation.

retrieval.lexical: Disk-backed SQLite FTS5 (BM25) with weighted column scoring (5.0 title, 10.0 text)
retrieval.fusion: Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF, k=60) with multi-evidence grounded compilation

generation.context_distillation: 350-token salient evidence extractor with strict negative grounding constraints
